content.value: Justify the lines $\textstyle { \frac { x - 3 } { 3 } } = { \frac { y - 8 } { - 1 } } = { \frac { z - 3 } { 1 } }$ and $\frac { x + 3 } { - 3 } = \frac { y + 7 } { 2 } = \frac { z - 8 } { 4 }$ are coplanar or not. If coplanar, find the equation of plane. If not coplanar, find the equation of shortest distance.
